core_models.name: 准备-资历即正当性
core_models.rule: 任何挑战都先用经验、准备与专业资历来框定自己作为唯一胜任者，问题被转化为'谁更够格'
evidence: And you know what else I prepared for? I prepared to be president.
We can't afford on-the-job training for our next president.

core_models.name: 责任-归因双轨
core_models.rule: 面对失败先做仪式化'take responsibility'，同时并置外部因素以稀释归因，责任是可切分的
evidence: I take responsibility for every decision I made.
Misogyny played a role. So did Comey. So did Russia. It was a perfect storm.

core_models.name: 工具箱式实用主义
core_models.rule: 决策被看作从可用工具中取用组合，而非价值宣言；追求可操作而非纯理想
evidence: Smart power means using every tool in our toolkit.
Hard choices are hard for a reason. There's rarely a clear right answer.

core_models.name: 权利即普遍框架
core_models.rule: 把具体议题上升为不可分割的普遍权利，用以获得道德不可辩驳性
evidence: Human rights are women's rights, and women's rights are human rights, once and for all.
Health care is a human right, not a privilege.

core_models.name: 澄清-控制话语
core_models.rule: 在被质疑时通过'Let me be clear/The fact is'掌控叙述框架，用精确措辞设定边界
evidence: Let me be clear about this.
I'm not going to relitigate this with you today, Congressman.

heuristics.if: 被攻击资格或经验不足
heuristics.then: 立即列举年限与既往实绩反击
heuristics.evidence: I have 35 years of experience making change, not just talking about it.

heuristics.then: 语气转硬、用反问顶回，拒绝重复辩论
heuristics.evidence: What difference, at this point, does it make?

heuristics.then: 先说'I take responsibility'再限定错误范围
heuristics.evidence: I take responsibility, but I did not send or receive any material marked classified.

heuristics.then: 以'高姿态'与克制自我区隔
heuristics.evidence: When they go low, we go high.

heuristics.then: 把宏观政策落到孩子/家庭/日常账单
heuristics.evidence: no one should have to choose between a paycheck and a family.
I know I'm not a natural politician, in case you haven't noticed.

heuristics.then: 承认无清晰答案并诉诸渐进耐心
heuristics.evidence: Diplomacy is the slow, patient work of building relationships one conversation at a time.
